documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management noted strong financial growth during the year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. Looking forward, the company aims to scale manufacturing utilization, expand non-textile binder applications, and improve revenue contribution from the manufacturing segment. The management also addressed questions regarding working capital, inventory, debt, and future capital expenditure plans. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for Q4 and FY26, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT alongside a transition from a trading model to a manufacturing-led model following the commissioning of its Vadodara facility.

guidance.claim: Management expects full capacity utilization of the Vadodara plant by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall EBITDA margins to increase by 200 to 300 basis points overall at full capacity.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management targets increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of the revenue mix in FY2027.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve full capacity of 500 tons per month by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing to be equal at 50% each within 1 to 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: Management maintains its expectation of closing the year around INR110 crores top line.
guidance.quote: No, of course the same. These two months, January and February, have also gone well for us.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the textile market is looked at around 15% to 20% and in the wood coating market around 20% to 30%.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant facility is fully operational and spread over 10 acres of land with a 72,000 square feet automated setup.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has further scope to expand manufacturing capacity by putting up vessels costing INR3 crores to INR5 crores according to requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Our company has successfully commenced production at its a 72,000 sq ft state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production has commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant and an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Kochi office was added during the quarter for domestic wood coating products.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration through in-house manufacturing is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, providing margin stability over the near term.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the manufacturing segment are around 20% to 25%, whereas for the trading business it is 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The transition from trading to manufacturing aims to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 revenue grew by 5.38% year-on-year to INR33.54 crores, while EBITDA increased by 130.78% to INR7.11 crores.
margins_costs.quote: In quarter 3 financial year '26, the company reported a revenue of INR33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, revenue recorded a sharp 78.54% increase compared to the quarter 2 of the financial year '26. The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA margin is around 20% to 25% and can be expected to near about 50% according to production.
margins_costs.quote: And the EBITDA margin you can say 20% to 25% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% due to manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: We are still importing the rest of the products. We are importing wood coating as well. But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new manufacturing facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first 2 months of starting manufacturing, capacity utilization was around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is confident that working capital will not become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: The long-term term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a bank loan, INR10 crores was funded through IPO for land, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: By December end, net worth stood at around INR42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to add new machinery over the next couple of months to expand the product portfolio and enter adjacent categories.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to share updates on trials for non-textile binder and glue products within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch some new products within 3 to 4 months following ongoing R&D work.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to strengthen presence in major garment hubs across India and expand through selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Strengthening presence in major garment hubs across India and expanding through selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies.
management_commitments.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.
